text: Genre: retro soul jingle, doo-wop tinged. BPM: 92. Key: E-flat major. Emotional progression: warm and wry throughout, swelling on the hook. Listening scenario: a late-night variety show number. Production profile: vintage, close-mic, plate reverb, slightly warm tape saturation. Vocals: smooth male crooner lead, velvety and unhurried, small melisma on the hook. Arrangement: upright bass and brushed drums under electric piano, a two-note baritone sax riff answering each line, finger snaps on the backbeat. The hook lands twice and the last line is held.
